result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers show the same five episodes side by side, with a warm, softened dark panel (#141210-ish background, lighter brown cards, subtle borders) rather than pure black. Both lighten the accent to a coral tone in dark mode, keep the muted durations readable, and use the accent only for the play buttons. The differences are cosmetic: B frames the two panels on a neutral backdrop with a title, and A uses a full-bleed split, so neither is meaningfully better on the rubric. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers show the same five episodes side by side in a light and a dark panel. Both dark themes use warm near-black backgrounds, slightly lighter card surfaces with subtle borders, and readable muted text. Each also uses a lightened coral accent only on the play buttons, so the two answers are almost equivalent. A's dark accent is a little brighter and B's is slightly softer, but neither difference is large enough to pick a winner.
